title: TRUNK-6729:  Let batch loading engage on the identifier and concept search paths
body:
<!--- Add a pull request title above in this format -->
<!--- real example: 'TRUNK-5111: Replace use of deprecated isVoided' -->
<!--- 'TRUNK-JiraIssueNumber: JiraIssueTitle' -->
## Description of what I changed
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
<!--- It can simply be your commit message, which you must have -->
  This attaches an empty `GraphSemantic.FETCH` entity graph to the identifier search query only,                                                                                     
  leaving the patient an uninitialized proxy so the batched load reaches the database first.                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                     
  - `SearchQueryUnique` — new `withLoadingOptions(...)`, applied to the page fetch only. Additive;                                                                                   
    unset, queries build exactly as before.                                                                                                                                          
  - `HibernatePatientDAO` — `unfetchedIdentifierHits()`, attached to both identifier searches.                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                     
  Prepared statements, 50-patient fixture: page of 5 → 20 before / 14 after; page of 40 →                                                                                            
  55 before / 14 after. Flat instead of one trip per extra result.                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                     
  The mapped fetch strategy is unchanged outside search (covered by a test). The concept path                                                                                        
  measured flat already, so it gets a regression test and no code change.
